text: Menkes 225 Birmingham Street Inc. are an appellant to Official Plan Amendment 231 (OPA 231) at the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT). City Council adopted OPA 231 policies for the entire city following the Five-Year Official Plan and Municipal Comprehensive Reviews regarding employment lands. The City Solicitor requires further directions for an upcoming LPAT pre-hearing conference.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 14, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (June 14, 2018) from the City Solicitor and City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 14, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 14, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council and are now public, as follows: 1.
